source.title: Single neurons in prefrontal cortex encode abstract rules.

confidence_rationale: Canonical demonstration that PFC single neurons explicitly encode abstract rules that generalise to novel stimuli -- direct evidence that a rule is a represented quantity with a neural substrate, grounding the existence of an ARC-063 CandidateRule representation. Held below top band: it shows rule CODING, not a FIELD of competing candidate rules with tolerance/eligibility attributes.
failure_signatures: Demonstrates that rules ARE encoded, but with only two rules in effect -- it does not show a population holding MANY candidate rules simultaneously, nor the per-rule attributes (tolerance, context-tags, evidence) ARC-063 requires.
Rule coding is reported at the single-neuron level; whether a distributed FIELD with graded availability exists is not addressed here (Weber 2023 subspace entry covers the population geometry).

mapping.source_claim_statement: Single neurons in monkey PFC most prevalently coded which of two abstract same/different rules was currently in effect; the rules generalised to pictures the monkeys had not previously experienced, showing genuine abstraction.
mapping.ree_translation: ARC-063 element (i) posits a represented CandidateRule. Wallis shows the foundational fact that an abstract rule IS an explicit, generalising representation carried by PFC neurons -- the substrate on which a CandidateRule field could be built. It confirms the rule is not merely an emergent policy smoothness (the MECH-309 worry) but a representable object.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Only two rules were in play; this grounds that rules are represented, NOT that a distributed field of many competing candidate rules with tolerance/eligibility/context attributes exists. ARC-063's field is a substantial elaboration beyond single-neuron rule coding.
mapping.source_context: Single-unit recording, macaque PFC, two abstract same/different rules with novel stimuli.

confidence_components.notes: Landmark Nature paper. Mapping fidelity good for 'rules are represented'; discounted because a multi-rule FIELD with attributes is not shown.
